title: CallScreenBench: Benchmarking Small Language Models as Phone Secretaries
abstract: arXiv:2608.01033v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language models small enough to run on a handset, quantized to a few bits, are increasingly capable of acting on their user's behalf -- which makes on-device task automation newly plausible. One such task is answering the phone. A phone secretary takes an unknown inbound call on its owner's behalf, and unlike the agents most benchmarks evaluate, it has no cooperative caller-assigned task to complete: the caller holds the goal and may be an adversary, while the secretary must begin deciding how to respond without an oracle. What matters is not task success but whether the owner would endorse how their proxy handled the call. We evaluate only the text-domain conversational decision layer; speech recognition, audio interaction, end-to-end latency, and handset execution are outside scope. We present CallScreenBench, which reports five automated call-and-note measure groups motivated by owner endorsement. Each is paired, where avail

translated_title: 通话屏幕基准测试：将小型语言模型作为电话秘书进行基准评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01033v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：足够小、能在手机上运行并量化为几比特的语言模型，越来越有能力代表用户执行操作——这使得设备端任务自动化变得可行。其中一个任务就是接电话。电话秘书代表机主接听未知来电，与大多数基准测试评估的代理不同，它没有合作方分配的任务需要完成：来电者掌握目标，且可能是对手，而秘书必须在没有外部提示的情况下开始决定如何回应。关键不在于任务成功，而在于机主是否认可代理处理电话的方式。我们仅评估文本领域的对话决策层；语音识别、音频交互、端到端延迟和手机执行不在范围内。我们提出了通话屏幕基准测试，该测试报告了五个自动通话和笔记测量组，这些测量组基于机主认可度，每项都配有（在可用时）...
tldr: 本文提出了通话屏幕基准测试，用于评估小型语言模型作为电话秘书的能力，重点关注机主认可度而非任务成功，并提供了五个自动测量组。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CallScreenBench, a benchmark for evaluating small language models as phone secretaries, focusing on owner endorsement rather than task success, with five automated measure groups.
